subject: reasoning
question: If L is the brother of M, M is the sister of O, and N is the father of O, how is L related to O?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given:

1) L is the brother of M.

2) M is the sister of O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7bd361a1b1ab23955d7a39e49cabcc20a5252dd38fcbb0575f22012363fb9913.png] 

3) N is the father of O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc31c09c1403b6cf3cd79b2c02bb772a789fb2a1e18308978dbb6e9a9228d5da.png] 

Thus, L is O's brother.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
